name: Generate YouTube Shorts and TikTok Videos with Vidu Q3 Turbo API via Pollo API

parameters.content:
## Generate YouTube Shorts and TikTok Videos with Vidu Q3 Turbo API via Pollo API

### Overview
Automate the creation of YouTube Shorts and TikTok videos from reference images using [Pollo API](https://api.pollo.ai)'s [Vidu Q3 Turbo API](https://docs.pollo.ai/m/vidu/viduq3-turbo) through this intuitive n8n workflow. Vidu Q3 Turbo focuses on fast video generation with synchronized audio and scene transitions, helping reference images become vivid short-form clips with movement, rhythm, and platform-ready energy.

**Key Benefits:**
- ⚡ Fast video generation for teams producing frequent short-form concepts from visual references.
- 🖼️ Reference image guidance for preserving a product, character, location, or visual style as the video anchor.
- 🔊 Synchronized audio support for Shorts and TikToks where sound cues shape the pace.
- 🎞️ Scene transition strength for turning static references into well-paced vertical video sequences.

### Perfect for
Short-form creators, social media teams, ecommerce brands, agencies, and content studios that need fast image-to-video workflows for YouTube Shorts and TikTok campaigns.

### Prerequisites
- [Pollo API account](https://api.pollo.ai) and API key ([Get your API key here](https://api.pollo.ai/api-keys)).
- Active n8n instance with form submission capabilities.
- AI prompts and publicly accessible reference image URLs for generation.

### Quick Setup

#### 1. **Get API Key**
Register at [api.pollo.ai](https://api.pollo.ai) and generate your API key.

#### 2. **Configure Form Fields**
Set up these fields in your "On Form Submission" node:
- **`prompt`** (Required): Detailed text description of the YouTube Short or TikTok video you want to generate from the reference image.
- **`image_url`** (Required): Public URL of the reference image you want to animate or use as the visual anchor.
- **`model_path`** (Required): Enter `vidu/viduq3-turbo` to route the request to the Vidu Q3 Turbo model.
- **`api_key`** (Required): Your Pollo AI API key for authentication.

#### 3. **Test & Use**
- Execute the workflow.
- Access the generated form URL.
- Fill in your details and submit.
- Wait for processing.
- Results will be displayed automatically.

### Usage Tips

**Anchor the Image, Then Direct the Motion:**
Use the reference image to define the subject and visual identity, then use the prompt to describe how the camera, subject, background, and audio should evolve.

**Better Prompts:**
Mention the platform style, desired pacing, subject motion, scene transition, lighting, and audio mood while keeping the reference image as the main visual source.

**Example:** "Create a vertical TikTok-style product video from this reference image: the sneaker rotates on a glossy studio floor, quick transition to an urban street close-up, energetic camera push-in, punchy synced audio, bold commercial feel."

**Common Uses:**
- TikTok product teasers from ecommerce images
- YouTube Shorts based on campaign visuals
- Reference-image fashion, beauty, and lifestyle clips
- Social ads created from static product photos
- Fast visual tests for influencer-style video concepts

### Troubleshooting
- **API Key Invalid**: Ensure your API key is correct and active.
- **Generation Fails**: Check whether your reference image URLs are publicly accessible and not behind a login. Also, make sure your prompt follows safety guidelines.

**Keywords:** Vidu Q3 Turbo API, Pollo API, Text-to-Video, Image-to-Video, Reference-to-Video, automated video ads, e-commerce video, YouTube Shorts, TikTok videos, native audio sync, n8n template, AI video workflow

## Capture and submit prompt

Starts the workflow from a form submission and sends the entered prompt and generation settings to the Pollo video generation API.

## Poll generation status

Waits for Pollo to process the video, queries the task status, and loops back to wait again until the generation is complete.

## Display generated video

Formats the completed generation response for output, including task ID, status, video URL, and media type.
